cases.why: GAP: identical fabrication to fabricated-employer-added, but the invented job sits on a '### ' heading line instead of a '**bold**' paragraph, with no bullet underneath. bodyProse() drops every line matching the heading regex before the containment scan ever sees it, on the theory that headings are structure we asked the model to add — but nothing stops a model from putting a fabricated employer THERE instead of in bold text. Confirmed empirically: findInventedFacts returns [] here (an earlier version of this case also had a bullet below the heading, which got caught for an unrelated reason — its own sentence-initial 'Directed' wasn't in the source — and masked this gap; that bullet was removed so the case isolates the real miss). Not weakened to pass; see notDone. [GAP CLOSED: findInventedFacts now catches this — heading text is scanned rather than dropped, and spelled-out quantities have their own case-insensitive pass.]
